title: Braydo's Screenshot Menu
description: This mod lets you see your screenshots through a menu in game!
body:
Braydo's Screenshot Menu is a simple client-side mod that lets you view your Minecraft screenshots through an in-game menu. Open your gallery without leaving the game, browse your screenshots, preview them, and quickly refresh the list whenever you take new ones.


**Screenshots to show what the in game menu looks like.**

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0d1dac859780ea008f0c764b7e0b2dbf41bfefb_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ffca930ec6df6f4e3c93a7aba9a4fc51ab80441.png)


**In the menu you are able to see the name of the screenshot image file and when it was taken!**

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef73af79b3454c45019ac3ab2677039f24682e23.png)

Also you can change the keybind to open the menu without going to the escape menu.


## Fixes/Changes

Nothing so far.
